column4: Siriniwes  Prajamithra  Sahayogitha
Kendraya (Incorporation) Act, No. 4 of 2010
The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column3: constituted are hereby  declared to be to —

column4: improve the economic standards of the poor families
living within Sri Lanka ;
collaborate  with  the  Government  activities  to
improve and maintain standard of education of  these
poor families;
assist  and  support  the  activities  to  eliminate
poverty and improve the financial standards  of the
poor;
support  the  activities  in  the  protection  and
conservation of the environment;
improve health and nutrition levels through social
activation  projects  and  to  provide  assistance  for
social welfare activities;
collaborate with any other Institution or Organization
in  Sri  Lanka  or  abroad  having  objects  similar  to
those  of  the  Corporation  and  to  exchange  views
and programmes with them;
assist  in  the  provision  of  books,  instrument,
clothing,  loans  and  other  financial  assistance  to
children  in  lower  income  families  which  need
assistance;
Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this Act  and  any  other

column3: written  law,  the  Corporation  shall  have  the  power  to  do,
perform  and  execute  all  such  acts,  matters  and  things
whatsoever, as are necessary or desirable for the promotion or
furtherance of the objects of the Corporation or any one of
them including the power to open, operate and close bank
